name: app-oviah-grid-system-documentation-4-column-diagram
title: OVIAH grid system: a labelled 4-column, 16px-gutter phone grid diagram with a rationale note
whatItIs: A white slide with a short rationale paragraph on the left and, on the right, a diagram of a rounded phone frame divided into four lilac columns each 16px apart, labelled '4 Column Grid' and '440px' for the total width.
whatItMeans: Rigorous and reusable; documenting the exact grid keeps every future screen consistent without guesswork.
techniques: Diagram a layout grid with exact pixel measurements.
Explain the grid's purpose in one short paragraph.
Show the grid overlaid on the actual device frame shape.

vocabulary.definition: The fixed space between grid columns.
An invisible structure of columns guiding alignment.
